title: Dimer
description: config.ini [Dimer] section (DimerConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

opt_method.description:
Optimization algorithm to choose the dimer rotation direction.

Options:
 - 'sd': Steepest descent, rotate along the rotational force.
 - 'cg': Conjugate gradient, rotate along conjugate directions.
 - 'lbfgs': Limited memory Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno Quasi-Newton optimizer.

converged_angle.description: The dimer is considered converged if it will be rotated fewer degrees than this angle.

rotations_max.description: This is the maximum number of rotations allowed for the dimer for each minimum mode estimation.

improved.description: Indicates if the improved dimer method is used.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations allowed for the dimer.

rotations_min.description: Minimum number of rotations for the dimer. [not improved]

torque_min.description: Minimum torque for the dimer. [not improved]

torque_max.description: Maximum torque for the dimer. [not improved]

remove_rotation.description:
Indicates if the rotation should be removed.

Implements the method of :cite:t:`dm-melanderRemovingExternalDegrees2015`
